en.s: The Battle of Vincy (or Vinchy, now Les Rues-des-Vignes) was a battle of the Frankish civil war of 715–18 fought near Cambrai, in the modern département of Nord. It was a contest between Charles Martel and the Austrasians on one side and the king of the Franks, Chilperic II, and his mayor of the palace, Ragenfrid, on the other. After the Battle of Amblève in 716, King Chilperic and Ragenfrid returned defeated to Neustria. Instead of following them at once, Charles again used tactics he would use all his remaining life, in a successful military career. He took time to rally more men and prepare, before descending in full force. By the following spring, Martel had attracted enough support to confront the Neustrians. He chose where to provoke them to battle, and, at a place and time of his choosing. Charles eventually followed them and dealt them a serious blow at Vincy on 21 March 717.

zh.s: 万西战役于717年3月21日在康布雷附近、今法国北部省境内发生，是715至718年法兰克内战的一部分。战场万西即今天的莱吕德维涅。交战双方为查理·马特及奥斯特拉西亚人，与法兰克国王希尔佩里克二世及其宫相拉根弗里德。716年安布莱夫战役后，希尔佩里克和拉根弗里德战败返回纽斯特里亚。查理没有立即追击，而是先花时间招募更多人员、做好准备，再集中兵力出击，这也成为他日后成功军事生涯中反复采用的做法。次年春，他已获得足够支持，能够正面挑战纽斯特里亚人，并主动选择交战时间和地点。最终，查理追上对手，在万西给予其沉重打击。

en.s: The Battle of York was fought between the Vikings of the Great Heathen Army and the Anglo-Saxon Kingdom of Northumbria on 21 March 867 in the city of York. Formerly controlled by the Roman Empire, York had been taken over by the Anglo-Saxons and had become the capital of the Kingdom of Northumbria. In 866 this kingdom was in the middle of a civil war, with Ælla and Osberht both claiming the crown.

zh.s: 867年3月21日，维京‘异教徒大军’与盎格鲁-撒克逊的诺森布里亚王国在约克城交战。约克曾受罗马帝国控制，后来由盎格鲁-撒克逊人接管，成为诺森布里亚首都。866年，该王国正陷于内战，埃拉与奥斯伯特都声称拥有王位。

en.s: The Erfurt massacre refers to the massacre of the Jewish community in Erfurt, Germany, on March 21, 1349. Accounts of the number of Jews killed in the massacre vary from over 100 to 1000 to approximately 3000, and some Jews set fire to their homes and possessions and perished in the flames before they could be lynched. The many Black Death persecutions and massacres that occurred in France and Germany at that time were sometimes in response to accusations that the Jews were responsible for outbreaks of the Black Death, and other times justified by the belief that killing the local Jews would prevent the spread of the Black Death to that locale.

zh.s: 1349年3月21日，德国埃尔福特的犹太社群遭到屠杀。对死者人数的记载差异很大，从100多人、1,000人到约3,000人不等。部分犹太人在遭私刑杀害前点燃房屋和财物，葬身火海。当时法国和德国发生许多与黑死病有关的迫害与屠杀，有时源于将瘟疫爆发归咎于犹太人的指控，有时则以‘杀死当地犹太人可以阻止瘟疫传入’的说法为理由。

en.s: The Battle of Chiset also known as the Battle of Chizai or Battle of Chizé was fought at Chizé on 21 March 1373 between English and French forces during the Hundred Years' War. The French had laid siege to the town and the English sent a relief force. The French, led by Bertrand du Guesclin, met the relief force and defeated it.

zh.s: 奇泽战役又称奇赛战役或奇泽城战役，于1373年3月21日在奇泽爆发，是英法百年战争的一部分。法国军队围攻该镇后，英军派出援军。贝特朗·杜·盖克兰率领法军迎战并击败了援军。

en.s: The Bishops' Wars were two wars fought in 1639 and 1640 between Charles I and his Covenanter opponents in Scotland. They were the first of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms, that also include the First and Second English Civil Wars, the Irish Confederate Wars, and the 1650 to 1652 Anglo-Scottish War. In 1637, Charles I, then king of Scotland and England, imposed changes in religious practice on the Church of Scotland.

zh.s: 主教战争是1639年与1640年查理一世和苏格兰盟约派之间的两场战争，也是三王国战争的开端；三王国战争还包括两次英国内战、爱尔兰同盟战争及1650至1652年的英苏战争。查理一世于1637年强制苏格兰教会改变宗教仪式，引发反对；盟约派于1639年3月21日占领爱丁堡城堡。

en.s: The Relief of Newark (21 March 1644) was a Royalist victory during the First English Civil War. It was a personal victory for Prince Rupert and it resulted in the Royalists holding Newark-on-Trent until almost the end of the war.

zh.s: 1644年3月21日，保王派在第一次英国内战的纽瓦克解围战中获胜。这也是鲁珀特亲王个人的一次胜利，使保王派得以一直控制特伦特河畔纽瓦克，几乎直到战争结束。

en.s: The Battle of Stow-on-the-Wold (21 March 1646) took place near Stow-on-the-Wold in Gloucestershire during the First English Civil War. It was a Parliamentarian victory by detachments of the New Model Army over the last Royalist field army. In the spring of 1646, King Charles I of England was getting ever more desperate to hold the Royalist cause together whilst waiting for the long promised relief forces from Ireland, Scotland and France.

zh.s: 斯托昂泽沃尔德战役于1646年3月21日在格洛斯特郡同名镇附近发生，是第一次英国内战的一场战斗。议会派新模范军的分遣部队，击败了保王派最后一支野战军。1646年春，英格兰国王查理一世一边等待爱尔兰、苏格兰和法国长期承诺派遣的援军，一边愈发艰难地维持保王派事业。

en.s: The Swedish conquest of Langeland (Danish: Erobringen af Langeland) was a Swedish amphibious invasion and conquest of the Danish island of Langeland in March 1659, during the Dano-Swedish War of 1658–1660. By performing a pincer movement through two different beachheads, the Swedes, commanded by Carl Gustaf Wrangel, managed to conquer the island despite resistance.

en.s: The Battle of Dornoch took place on 20 March 1746 and was part of the Jacobite rising of 1745 in Scotland. However, although recorded in history as a "battle" there was no actual fighting between the two sides. Instead a large rebel Jacobite force advanced on a position held by a force loyal to the British-Hanoverian Government who were taken by surprise and forced into a retreat.

en.s: The Battle of Grünberg (21 March 1761) was fought between French and allied Prussian and Hanoverian troops in the Seven Years' War at village of Grünberg, Hesse, near Stangenrod. The French, led by the Jacques Philippe de Choiseul, inflicted a significant defeat on the allies, taking several thousand prisoners, and capturing 18 military standards. The allied loss prompted Duke Ferdinand of Brunswick to lift the siege of Cassel and retreat.

zh.s: 1761年3月21日，七年战争期间，法国军队与普鲁士、汉诺威联军，在黑森州施坦根罗德附近的格林贝格村交战。雅克·菲利普·德·舒瓦瑟尔率领法军重创联军，俘获数千人及18面军旗。联军战败后，不伦瑞克的斐迪南公爵被迫解除对卡塞尔的围攻，向后撤退。

en.s: The Battle of the Catalina River was a military engagement fought on March 21, 1784 during the Spanish conquest of the present day Arizona. The combatants were Apache and Navajo warriors, Spanish soldiers and Tucson militia.

en.s: The Fourth Battle of Tucson was a raid during the lengthy wars between Spanish colonists in Arizona and its region and Apache Indians. At break of day, on March 21, 1784, a force of no more than 500 Apaches and Navajos attacked Spanish cavalry guards protecting a herd of livestock at the Presidio San Augustin del Tucson in southern Arizona.

zh.s: 第四次图森战役是西班牙殖民者与阿帕奇人在亚利桑那及周边地区长期战争中的一次突袭。1784年3月21日拂晓，不超过500名阿帕奇与纳瓦霍战士，袭击了亚利桑那南部图森圣奥古斯丁要塞外保护牲畜群的西班牙骑兵卫队。

en.s: The Great New Orleans Fire (1788) was a fire that destroyed 856 of the 1,100 structures in New Orleans, Louisiana (New Spain), on March 21, 1788, spanning the south central Vieux Carré from Burgundy to Chartres Street, almost to the Mississippi River front buildings. An additional 212 buildings were destroyed in a later city-wide fire, on December 8, 1794.

zh.s: 1788年3月21日，当时属于新西班牙的路易斯安那新奥尔良发生大火，1,100栋建筑中有856栋被毁。火势波及老城区中南部，从勃艮第街延伸至沙特尔街，几乎烧到密西西比河岸建筑。1794年12月8日，该城又发生大火，再毁212栋建筑。

en.s: The Siege of Bangalore was a siege of the town and fortifications of Bangalore during the Third Anglo-Mysore War by forces of the British East India Company, led by Charles, Earl Cornwallis against a Mysorean garrison, while Tipu Sultan, Mysore's ruler, harried the camps and positions of the besiegers. Arriving before the town on 5 February 1791, Cornwallis captured the town by assault on 7 February, and after six weeks of siege, stormed the fortress on 21 March.

en.s: The Battle of Ostrach, also called the Battle by Ostrach, occurred on 20–21 March 1799. It was the first non-Italy-based battle of the War of the Second Coalition. The battle resulted in the victory of the Austrian forces, under the command of Archduke Charles, over the French forces, commanded by Jean-Baptiste Jourdan. The battle occurred during Holy Week, 1799, amid rain and dense fog.

en.s: The Battle of Alexandria (also known as the Battle of Canope/Canopus) was fought on 21 March 1801, where the British army and naval forces repelled an assault by the French army as part of the French invasion of Egypt and Syria. Led by General Sir Ralph Abercromby, the British entrenched army engaged a French force under Divisional-general Jacques-François Menou near the ruins of Nicopolis, on the narrow spit of land between the Mediterranean Sea and Abukir.

zh.s: 亚历山大港战役又称卡诺普斯战役，于1801年3月21日爆发。作为法国入侵埃及和叙利亚的一部分，英国陆军和海军击退了法军进攻。拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比爵士将军率领的英军在尼科波利斯遗址附近与雅克-弗朗索瓦·梅努少将指挥的法军交战。战场是一条位于地中海和阿布基尔湾之间的狭长地带。

en.s: The surrender of Saint Barthélemy occurred during the War of the Second Coalition. On 19 March, a British fleet arrived off the Swedish colony of Saint Barthélemy and demanded its surrender. Britain had moved to occupy the colony as part of deteriorating Anglo-Swedish relations resulting from Sweden's decision to join the Second League of Armed Neutrality.

zh.s: 第二次反法同盟战争期间，英国舰队于1801年3月19日抵达瑞典殖民地圣巴泰勒米岛外并要求投降，岛上于3月21日正式向英国将领托马斯·特里格和约翰·托马斯·达克沃思投降。英国占领该岛，背景是瑞典加入第二次武装中立联盟后英瑞关系恶化。

en.s: The Napoleonic Code (French: Code Napoléon), officially the Civil Code of the French (French: Code civil des Français; simply referred to as Code civil), is the French civil code established during the French Consulate in 1804 and still in force in France, although heavily and frequently amended since its inception.

en.s: The Åland Offensive was part of a threefold attack on native Sweden by the Russian Empire during the Finnish War, to force Sweden into the Continental System and to give up Finland. Åland was to be used for an immediate attack on Stockholm. Only minor skirmishes occurred when Gotthard Johann von Knorring launched his Åland offensive on 10 March 1809, since the Swedes under Georg Carl von Döbeln quickly withdrew over the ice to Stockholm.

zh.s: 芬兰战争期间，俄罗斯帝国向瑞典本土发动三路攻势，意在迫使瑞典加入大陆封锁体系并放弃芬兰，其中奥兰群岛将作为立即进攻斯德哥尔摩的基地。戈特哈德·约翰·冯·克诺林于1809年3月10日发动奥兰攻势，乔治·卡尔·冯·德贝尔恩率瑞军迅速踏冰撤向斯德哥尔摩，仅发生小规模交火。3月21日双方签订《奥兰协定》，俄军停止攻势。

On the second day of fighting, Emperor Napoleon finally realized he had blundered into battle as he was massively outnumbered, and immediately ordered a masked retreat.

zh.s: 阿尔西斯-欧布战役于1814年3月20日至21日爆发。第六次反法同盟战争期间，拿破仑率领法兰西帝国军队迎战由卡尔·菲利普·施瓦岑贝格亲王率领、规模大得多的联军。第二天，拿破仑终于意识到自己误入战场且兵力远远不足，随即下令掩护撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Noukouma was fought on 21 March 1818 between a small force of jihadists led by Seku Amadu and a Bamana force led by General Jamogo Séri. It was the first and most significant battle of Seku Amdadu's jihad and saw an unexpected jihadist victory against the numerically superior Bamana army. The victory was interpreted as a divine miracle by many and allowed Seku Amadu to rapidly expand his army to over 40,000.

zh.s: 努库马战役于1818年3月21日爆发。塞库·阿马杜率领一支小规模圣战者部队，与贾莫戈·塞里将军率领的巴马纳军队交战。这是塞库·阿马杜圣战中的首场，也是最重要的一场战役。人数处于劣势的圣战者意外获胜。许多人将胜利视为神迹，塞库·阿马杜因此迅速扩军，兵力增至4万多人。

en.t: Greek War of Independence: Greek revolutionaries seize Kalavryta
en.s: The Greek War of Independence, also known as the Greek Revolution or the Greek Revolution of 1821, was a successful war of independence fought by Greek revolutionaries against the Ottoman Empire from 1821 to 1829. In 1826, the Greeks were assisted by the British Empire, the Kingdom of France, and the Russian Empire, while the Ottomans were aided by their vassals, especially by the Eyalet of Egypt.

zh.t: 希腊独立战争：希腊革命者攻占卡拉夫里塔
zh.s: 希腊独立战争也称希腊革命或1821年希腊革命，是希腊革命者于1821年至1829年对抗奥斯曼帝国、最终取得胜利的一场独立战争。1826年，希腊人得到大英帝国、法兰西王国和俄罗斯帝国援助；奥斯曼人则得到其附庸势力支持，尤其是埃及行省。

en.t: The Wellington–Winchilsea duel takes place in London involving the Prime Minister the Duke of Wellington
en.s: The Wellington-Winchilsea Duel took place on 21 March 1829 at Battersea, then in Surrey on the outskirts of London. It was a bloodless duel fought between the British prime minister Arthur Wellesley, 1st Duke of Wellington and George Finch-Hatton, 10th Earl of Winchilsea. It was the second and last duel fought by a sitting prime minister following the 1798 Pitt–Tierney duel on Putney Heath.

zh.s: 惠灵顿-温奇尔西决斗于1829年3月21日在巴特西举行，当时巴特西属于萨里郡，位于伦敦郊外。这是一场没有人受伤的决斗，参与者是英国首相、第一代惠灵顿公爵阿瑟·韦尔斯利和第十代温奇尔西伯爵乔治·芬奇-哈顿。这是继1798年皮特-蒂尔尼决斗后，现任英国首相参与的第二场、也是最后一场决斗。

en.s: The Capture of Lucknow (Hindi: लखनऊ का क़ब्ज़ा, Urdu: لکھنؤ کا قبضہ) was a battle of Indian rebellion of 1857. The British recaptured the city of Lucknow which they had abandoned in the previous winter after the relief of a besieged garrison in the Residency, and destroyed the organised resistance by the rebels in the Kingdom of Awadh (or Oudh, as it was referred to in most contemporary accounts).

zh.s: 勒克瑙陷落是1857年印度起义中的一场战斗。英国军队重新夺回勒克瑙城；此前，他们在前一个冬天解救驻地被围的守军后撤离了这座城市。英军还摧毁了奥德王国叛军的有组织抵抗。

en.s: The second siege of Veracruz was a military encounter of Mexico's Reform War that took place around the port of Veracruz in 1860. Conservative President Miguel Miramón besieged the Liberal capital, Veracruz, for over a month but was compelled to withdraw after he ran out of ammunition. Part of his problem was that he was unable to blockade the port by sea due to the intervention of the United States off Antón Lizardo (see Battle of Antón Lizardo).

zh.t: 韦拉克鲁斯第二次围城战
zh.s: 韦拉克鲁斯第二次围城战是墨西哥改革战争中的一次军事冲突，1860年发生在韦拉克鲁斯港周边。保守派总统米格尔·米拉蒙围困自由派的首都韦拉克鲁斯一个多月，但弹药耗尽后被迫撤退。由于美国在安东·利萨尔多附近介入，他未能从海上封锁港口，这也是围城失败的原因之一。

en.s: The Battle of Henderson's Hill (March 21, 1864), also known as the Bayou Rapides, saw a reinforced Union Army division led by Brigadier General Joseph A. Mower opposed by a regiment of Confederate Army cavalry and attached artillery under Colonel William G. Vincent. That evening, during a rainstorm, Mower sent one infantry brigade on a circuitous march to gain the rear of Vincent's command.

zh.s: 亨德森山战役于1864年3月21日爆发，又称拉皮德斯河口战役。约瑟夫·A.莫尔少将率领一支得到增援的联邦军师，对阵威廉·G.文森特上校率领的一支邦联军骑兵团及其炮兵部队。当晚下雨时，莫尔派出一个步兵旅绕行，试图迂回到文森特部队后方。

en.s: The Harmony skirmish was a small engagement of the American Civil War between Confederate forces under Colonel John Mosby and Union forces under Colonel Marcus Reno on March 21, 1865, near the village of Harmony (present-day Hamilton) in Loudoun County, Virginia. A Union raiding party that was sent into Loudoun County to eliminate Confederate partisans was ambushed by Mosby's Rangers near the village of Harmony.

zh.s: 1865年3月21日，美国内战期间，约翰·莫斯比上校指挥的南军与马库斯·里诺上校指挥的北军，在弗吉尼亚州劳登县哈莫尼村、今汉密尔顿附近发生小规模交战。一支北军突袭队奉命进入劳登县清除南军游击队，却在哈莫尼附近遭莫斯比游骑兵伏击。

en.s: The Ontario general election of 1871 was the second general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on March 21, 1871, to elect the 82 Members of the 2nd Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Edward Blake, won a slim majority of the seats, and formed the government. The Ontario Conservative Party, led by John Sandfield Macdonald, served as the official opposition.

zh.s: 加拿大安大略省于1871年3月21日举行第二次省大选，选出第2届省议会82名议员。爱德华·布莱克领导的安大略自由党以微弱优势取得多数席位并组阁，约翰·桑菲尔德·麦克唐纳领导的安大略保守党成为官方反对党。

en.s: The 1874 Scottish Cup final was the inaugural final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1873–74 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match took place at Hampden Park on 21 March 1874 and was contested by Queen's Park and Clydesdale. Queen's Park won the match 2–0 with goals from Billy MacKinnon and Robert Leckie.

zh.s: 1874年苏格兰杯决赛是该赛事首届决赛，也是1873—74赛季、苏格兰最负盛名的淘汰制足球赛事的最后一场比赛。决赛于1874年3月21日在汉普顿公园球场举行，由女王公园对阵克莱兹代尔。比利·麦金农和罗伯特·莱基各入一球，帮助女王公园以2比0获胜。

en.s: The 1891 FA Cup final was contested by Blackburn Rovers and Notts County at the Kennington Oval. Blackburn won 3–1, their second consecutive FA Cup Final victory, with goals by Geordie Dewar, Jack Southworth and William Townley. James Oswald scored Notts County's goal.

zh.s: 1891年英格兰足总杯决赛由布莱克本流浪者对阵诺茨郡，在肯宁顿椭圆球场举行。布莱克本以3比1获胜，连续第二年夺冠。乔治·杜瓦、杰克·索思沃思和威廉·汤利为布莱克本进球，詹姆斯·奥斯瓦尔德为诺茨郡打入一球。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 21 March 1897, with a second round of voting on 28 March. The "Ministerial" left-wing bloc, led by Giovanni Giolitti remained the largest in Parliament, winning 327 of the 508 seats.

zh.s: 意大利于1897年3月21日举行大选，3月28日进行第二轮投票。乔瓦尼·焦利蒂领导的左翼‘政府派’集团赢得508席中的327席，保持议会最大集团地位。

zh.s: 德军第九集团军在维斯瓦河以西与俄军交战；在胡明和沃拉希德沃夫斯卡的战斗结束后，这一战区一度平静，尤其是俄军第二集团军正面。资料框记载战斗持续至1915年3月21日，当天德军指挥官冯·弗罗梅尔停止进攻。

en.s: The First Battle of Kekava occurred in March 1916 in Kekava, Latvia, along the Eastern Front during World War I.

zh.s: 第一次凯卡瓦战役于1916年3月在拉脱维亚凯卡瓦发生，是第一次世界大战东线的一场战斗。

en.s: The German spring offensive, also known as Kaiserschlacht ("Emperor's Battle") or the Ludendorff offensive, was a series of German attacks along the Western Front during the First World War, beginning on 21 March 1918. Following the American entry into the war in April 1917, the Germans decided that their only remaining chance of victory was to defeat the Allies before the United States could ship soldiers across the Atlantic and fully deploy its resources.

zh.s: 德军春季攻势又称‘皇帝会战’或鲁登道夫攻势，是第一次世界大战期间德军自1918年3月21日起，在西线发动的一系列进攻。美国于1917年4月参战后，德国认为仅存的获胜机会，是赶在美国将大批士兵运过大西洋、全面投入其资源之前，击败协约国。

en.s: The Battle of Hijla (21 March 1918) was fought by the forces of the British and Turkish Empires during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. Hijla (now called Makhadet Hijla', lit. 'Partridge Ford'; cf. nearby Deir Hajla) is on the River Jordan a few miles upriver from the Dead Sea.

zh.s: 希吉拉战役于1918年3月21日爆发，是第一次世界大战西奈和巴勒斯坦战役的一部分，交战双方为大英帝国和奥斯曼帝国的部队。希吉拉现称马克哈代特·希吉拉，意为“鹧鸪渡口”；它位于约旦河沿岸，距死海上游数英里。

en.s: The Finnish term Heimosodat (singular heimosota) refers to a series of armed conflicts and private military expeditions in 1918–1922 into areas of the former Russian Empire that bordered on Finland and were inhabited in large part by other Finnic peoples. The term has been translated into English as "Kindred Nations Wars", "Wars for kindred peoples", "Kinfolk wars", or "Kinship Wars," specifically referring to Finnic kinship.

zh.s: 芬兰语“Heimosodat”（单数形式为heimosota）指1918年至1922年间一系列武装冲突和私人军事远征，发生在与芬兰接壤、原属俄罗斯帝国且居民多为其他芬兰-乌戈尔民族的地区。这个词在英语中译作“亲缘民族战争”“为亲缘民族而战”“同族战争”或“亲族战争”，特指芬兰人与其他芬兰-乌戈尔民族之间的亲缘关系。

en.t: The Hungarian Soviet Republic is established becoming the first Communist government to be formed in Europe after the October Revolution in Russia
en.s: The Hungarian Soviet Republic, also known as the Socialist Federative Soviet Republic of Hungary was a short-lived state that existed from 21 March 1919 to 1 August 1919 (133 days), succeeding the First Hungarian Republic. The Hungarian Soviet Republic was a small rump state run by communists and socialists which, at its time of establishment, controlled approximately only 23% of Hungary's historic territory.

zh.t: 匈牙利苏维埃共和国成立
zh.s: 匈牙利苏维埃共和国又称匈牙利社会主义联邦苏维埃共和国，是一个短命政权，于1919年3月21日至8月1日存在，共133天，接替匈牙利第一共和国。该国由共产党和社会主义者执政，成立时实际控制的领土约占历史上的匈牙利23%。

en.s: On 21 March 1920 local elections were held in Zagreb, the first ones in the newly formed Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes. The incumbent mayor was Stjepan Srkulj from the Croatian Union party, who took office in 1917. Svetozar Delić of the Socialist Workers' Party of Yugoslavia was elected mayor, but his term lasted only six days before being suspended by the government.

zh.s: 1920年3月21日，萨格勒布举行塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国新成立后的首次地方选举。现任市长为克罗地亚联盟的斯捷潘·斯尔库利，自1917年起任职。南斯拉夫社会主义工人党的斯韦托扎尔·德利奇当选市长，但任期仅六天便被政府停职。

en.s: The Headford Ambush was carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) on 21 March 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. The IRA's 2nd Kerry Brigade ambushed a train carrying British troops of the Royal Fusiliers at Headford Junction railway station near Killarney, County Kerry. This sparked a battle lasting almost an hour, in which at least 13 people were killed – nine British soldiers, two IRA volunteers and three civilians.

zh.s: 爱尔兰共和军于1921年3月21日在爱尔兰独立战争期间发动黑德福德伏击战。爱尔兰共和军凯里第二旅在凯里郡基拉尼附近的黑德福德枢纽站伏击了一列载有英国皇家燧发枪团士兵的火车。战斗持续近一小时，至少造成13人死亡，其中包括9名英国士兵、2名爱尔兰共和军志愿人员和3名平民。

en.t: Ravel's opera L'enfant et les sortilèges, to a libretto by Colette, is premiered at the Opéra de Monte-Carlo
en.s: L'enfant et les sortilèges: Fantaisie lyrique en deux parties (The Child and the Spells: A Lyric Fantasy in Two Parts) is an opera in one act, with music by Maurice Ravel to a libretto by Colette. It is Ravel's second opera, his first being L'heure espagnole. Written from 1917 to 1925, L'enfant et les sortilèges was first performed in Monte Carlo on 21 March 1925, conducted by Victor de Sabata.

zh.t: 拉威尔歌剧《孩子与魔法》首演
zh.s: 《孩子与魔法：两部分抒情幻想曲》是一部独幕歌剧，由莫里斯·拉威尔作曲、科莱特撰写剧本，也是拉威尔的第二部歌剧，第一部是《西班牙时光》。拉威尔于1917年至1925年间创作这部作品，歌剧于1925年3月21日在蒙特卡洛首演，由维克托·德·萨巴塔指挥。

en.s: The Butler Act was a 1925 Tennessee law prohibiting public school teachers from denying the Genesis account of humankind's origin. The law also prevented the teaching of the evolution of humans from what it referred to as lower orders of animals in place of the Biblical account. The law was introduced by Tennessee House of Representatives member John Washington Butler, for whom the law was named.

zh.s: 巴特勒法案是田纳西州于1925年通过的一项法律，禁止公立学校教师否认《创世记》关于人类起源的说法，也禁止教师用动物进化论取代《圣经》的说法。法案由田纳西州众议员约翰·华盛顿·巴特勒提出，并以他的名字命名。

en.s: The Holland with Boston by-election, 1929 was a by-election held on 21 March 1929 for the British House of Commons constituency of Holland with Boston in Lincolnshire. The by-election was caused by the death of the town's Unionist Party Member of Parliament (MP) Arthur Dean, who had held the seat at the 1924 general election. At that election, Labour came second and the Liberals third. Labour had won the seat in 1918, but it had been gained by the Unionists in a by-election just before the 1924 general election.

zh.s: 英国下议院位于林肯郡的霍兰与波士顿选区，于1929年3月21日举行补选。联合党议员阿瑟·迪恩去世，留下议席空缺。他曾在1924年大选中保住该席，当时工党位居第二，自由党第三。工党曾在1918年赢得该选区，但联合党在1924年大选前的一次补选中夺走席位。

en.s: The Ponce massacre was an event that took place on Palm Sunday, 21 March 1937, in Ponce, Puerto Rico, when a peaceful civilian march turned into a police shooting in which 19 civilians and two policemen were killed, and more than 200 others wounded. Most of the dead were reportedly shot in their backs. The march had been organized by the Puerto Rican Nationalist Party to commemorate the abolition of slavery in Puerto Rico by the governing Spanish National Assembly in 1873, and to protest the U.S. Government's imprisonment of the Party's leader, Pedro Albizu Campos, on sedition charges.

zh.s: 1937年3月21日圣枝主日，波多黎各庞塞的一场和平民众游行遭警方开枪，造成19名平民和两名警察死亡，另有200多人受伤。据报道，多数死者背部中弹。游行由波多黎各民族党组织，既纪念西班牙国民议会于1873年废除波多黎各奴隶制，也抗议美国政府以煽动叛乱罪监禁该党领袖佩德罗·阿尔维苏·坎波斯。

en.s: The 1940 Alberta general election was held on March 21, 1940, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta. Despite its failure to implement its key policy, providing prosperity certificates to all Albertans, the Social Credit Party of Premier William Aberhart won a second term in government. Nevertheless, it lost eleven seats that it had won in the 1935 landslide.

zh.s: 艾伯塔省于1940年3月21日举行大选，选出省立法议会议员。由威廉·阿伯哈特省长领导的社会信用党未能落实向所有艾伯塔居民发放繁荣券这一核心政策，但仍赢得第二个执政任期。与1935年大胜时相比，该党这次失去了11个席位。

en.t: Wehrmacht officer Rudolf von Gersdorff plots to assassinate Adolf Hitler by using a suicide bomb, but the plan falls through; von Gersdorff is able to defuse the bomb in time and avoid suspicion
en.s: Rudolf-Christoph Freiherr von Gersdorff (27 March 1905 – 27 January 1980) was an officer in the German Army. As a Wehrmacht intelligence officer, he attempted to assassinate Adolf Hitler by suicide bombing on 21 March 1943; the plan failed when Hitler left early, but Gersdorff was undetected. That same month, soldiers from his unit discovered the mass graves of the Soviet-perpetrated Katyn massacre.

zh.t: 鲁道夫·冯·格斯多夫刺杀希特勒未遂
zh.s: 德国国防军军官鲁道夫-克里斯托夫·冯·格斯多夫男爵于1943年3月21日试图以自杀式炸弹袭击刺杀阿道夫·希特勒。希特勒提前离开，计划失败，但格斯多夫没有暴露身份。同月，他所在部队的士兵发现了苏联实施的卡廷大屠杀乱葬坑。

en.s: Operation Carthage, on 21 March 1945, was a British World War II air raid on Copenhagen, Denmark, which incurred significant collateral damage. The target of the raid was the Shellhus, used as Gestapo headquarters in the city centre. It was used for the storage of dossiers and the torture of Danish citizens during interrogations. The Danish Resistance had long asked the British to conduct a raid against this site. As a result, the building was destroyed, 18 prisoners were freed, and anti-resistance Nazi activities were disrupted.

zh.s: 1945年3月21日，第二次世界大战期间，英国对丹麦哥本哈根实施代号‘迦太基行动’的空袭，造成严重附带损害。目标是市中心被盖世太保用作总部的壳牌大楼，那里存放档案，并在审讯中酷刑折磨丹麦公民。丹麦抵抗组织长期请求英国空袭该处。行动摧毁大楼，释放18名囚犯，并扰乱了纳粹镇压抵抗运动的活动。

en.s: The Battle of the Transdanubian Hills (also known in Bulgaria as the Drava Operation (Bulgarian: Дравска операция, Dravska operatsiya)) was a defensive operation of the Bulgarian First Army during Bulgaria's participation in World War II against German Wehrmacht forces, who were trying to capture the north bank of the Drava river as part of Operation Spring Awakening. Combat in the Transdanubian Hills lasted from 6 to 21 March 1945.
en.n: World War II: Bulgaria and the Soviet Union successfully complete their defense of the north bank of the Drava River as the Battle of the Transdanubian Hills concludes.

zh.s: 多瑙河外山地战役又称德拉瓦行动，是保加利亚第一军在第二次世界大战期间的一次防御行动。保加利亚参战后与德意志国防军交战；德军试图在“春季觉醒行动”期间夺取德拉瓦河北岸。战斗于1945年3月6日至21日持续进行。

zh.s: 1946年3月21日，洛杉矶公羊队签下黑人球员肯尼·华盛顿。此前，美国国家橄榄球联盟已连续12个赛季没有黑人球员参赛。

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 21 March 1959 to elect all 50 members to the Legislative Assembly. The result was a hung parliament—the two-term Labor government, led by Premier Albert Hawke, was defeated with an average swing against it of about 7 per cent, but the Liberal-Country Party coalition, led by Opposition Leader David Brand, won exactly half of the seats, and needed the support of at least one of the two Independent Liberal members to obtain a majority in the Assembly.

zh.s: 西澳大利亚州于1959年3月21日举行选举，改选立法议会全部50个席位。选举结果造成悬峙议会：由州长阿尔伯特·霍克领导、已执政两届的工党政府落败，得票率平均下降约7个百分点；由反对党领袖戴维·布兰德领导的自由党与乡村党联盟恰好获得一半席位，需要至少一名独立自由党议员支持才能在议会取得多数。

en.s: The Battle of Suoi Tre (Vietnamese: suối Tre) occurred during the early morning of 21 March 1967 during Operation Junction City, a search and destroy mission by American military forces in Tay Ninh Province of South Vietnam, to the west of the capital Saigon. After being challenged heavily to begin with, the Americans gained the upper hand and completed a convincing victory over the Viet Cong. They found 647 bodies and captured seven prisoners, 65 crew-served and 94 individual weapons. The Americans losses were 36 dead and 190 wounded, a fatality ratio of more than twenty to one in their favour.

en.s: The Battle of Karameh (Arabic: معركة الكرامة‎‎) was a 15-hour military engagement between the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) and combined forces of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) and the Jordanian Armed Forces (JAF) in the Jordanian town of Karameh on 21 March 1968, during the War of Attrition. It was planned by Israel as one of two concurrent raids on PLO camps, one in Karameh and one in the distant village of Safi—codenamed Operation Inferno (Hebrew: מבצע תופת‎‎) and Operation Asuta (מבצע אסותא), respectively—but the former turned into a full-scale battle.

en.t: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
en.s: The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) is the UN process for negotiating an agreement to limit dangerous climate change. It is an international treaty among countries to combat "dangerous human interference with the climate system". The main way to do this is limiting the increase in greenhouse gases in the atmosphere. The Convention established the principle of "common but differentiated responsibilities," which asserts that all countries share responsibility for addressing climate change.

zh.t: 《联合国气候变化框架公约》生效

en.s: The 2001 Castel by-election was held in the States of Guernsey district of Castel on 21 March 2001, following the resignation of deputy David John Nussbaumer due to other time commitments and frustrations with the current government. Medical doctor Hunter Adam was elected with 27.51% of the vote, defeating Pat Wisher and five other candidates. There were two polling stations at Castel Douzaine Room and Beaucamp Road.

en.s: General elections were held in Niue on 21 March 2002 to determine the composition of the twenty member national Assembly. All twenty outgoing members were re-elected, of which eight (all of them village representatives) were running unopposed. Voter turnout was close to 100%. The Niue People's Party obtained six seats, and was able to form a government with the support of eight independent members. The remaining six seats were also held by independents. Young Vivian (NPP) became Premier. Sani Lakatani was his deputy.

zh.s: 纽埃于2002年3月21日举行大选，选出20名国民议会议员。全部20名原任议员均获连任，其中8名均为村级代表，没有竞争对手。投票率接近100%。纽埃人民党赢得6席，获得8名独立议员支持而得以组阁，其余6席也由独立人士持有。人民党的扬·维维安出任总理，萨尼·拉卡塔尼担任副总理。

en.t: Homenaje a Dos Leyendas: El Santo y Salvador Lutteroth (2003)
en.s: Homenaje a Dos Leyendas: El Santo y Salvador Lutteroth (2003) (Spanish for "Homage to Two Legends: El Santo and Salvador Lutteroth") was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL), which took place on March 21, 2003 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. The event was to honor and remember CMLL founder Salvador Lutteroth who died in March 1987. It also honored El Santo, the most famous Mexican professional wrestler ever. The name of the annual March event would later be shortened to just Homenaje a Dos Leyendas after CMLL had a falling out with El Santo's son El Hijo del Santo, with the event honoring a different wrestler along with Lutteroth.

zh.t: 2003年致敬两位传奇：圣者与萨尔瓦多·卢特罗特
zh.s: 2003年‘致敬两位传奇：圣者与萨尔瓦多·卢特罗特’是世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的大型职业摔角赛事，于3月21日在墨西哥墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，纪念于1987年3月去世的CMLL创始人卢特罗特，同时致敬墨西哥最著名的职业摔角手‘圣者’。后来，CMLL与圣者之子El Hijo del Santo关系破裂，这项每年3月举行的赛事便更名为‘致敬两位传奇’，改为每年选择不同摔角手与卢特罗特共同接受致敬。

en.s: A general election was held on Sunday, 21 March 2004 for members of the 11th Parliament of Malaysia. Voting took place in all 219 parliamentary constituencies of Malaysia, each electing one Member of Parliament to the Dewan Rakyat, the dominant house of Parliament. State elections also took place in 505 state constituencies in 12 out of 13 states of Malaysia (except Sarawak) on the same day.

en.s: A presidential election was held in El Salvador on Sunday, 21 March 2004. The Salvadoran people elected a new president, together with his vice-president, for a five-year term. Antonio "Tony" Saca of the ARENA party won the election. El Salvador's constitution provides for a second-round runoff vote in the event that no candidate secures an absolute majority; however, Saca's 57% share of the vote meant that the second round, scheduled for 2 May, would not take place.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于2004年3月21日星期日举行总统选举，选出任期五年的新总统及副总统。民族主义共和联盟的安东尼奥·‘托尼’·萨卡获胜。宪法规定，若无候选人获得绝对多数，须进行第二轮投票；但萨卡获得57%的选票，因此原定5月2日举行的第二轮无需进行。

en.s: The 2004 Sabah state election was held on Sunday, 21 March 2004, concurrently with the Malaysian general election, 2004. This election featured 12 new state seats increasing the total seats from 48 to 60. There was also an additional three parliament seats in Sabah following the 2003 delineation of electoral boundaries. The Barisan Nasional (BN) coalition comprehensively won this election after the only major opposition party in Sabah Parti Bersatu Sabah joined the BN coalition in 2002.

zh.s: 2004年沙巴州选举于3月21日星期日举行，与马来西亚全国大选同日进行。此次增加12个州议席，使总席位数从48增至60；2003年选区划界也为沙巴增加了3个国会席位。沙巴唯一主要反对党沙巴团结党于2002年加入国民阵线后，国阵在此次选举中全面获胜。

en.s: On March 21, 2005, a domestic double homicide followed by a mass shooting occurred at two locations in the Red Lake Indian Reservation in Red Lake, Minnesota, United States. That afternoon, 16-year-old Jeff Weise killed his grandfather (an Ojibwe Red Lake police sergeant) and his grandfather's girlfriend at home. After taking his grandfather's police weapons and bulletproof vest, Weise drove his grandfather's police car to Red Lake Senior High School, where he was enrolled.

en.t: 2007 Czech Social Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The Czech Social Democratic Party (ČSSD) leadership election of 2007 was held on 21 March 2007. Jiří Paroubek was reelected as party's leader. Election was marked by conflict between Paroubek and his predecessor Miloš Zeman. Jaroslav Foldyna announced that he considers running against Paroubek. Foldyna was a supporter of Miloš Zeman. Zeman himself endorsed Foldyna's candidature. Some members of parliament publicly expressed their support for Foldyna.

en.s: The 2007 Norfolk Island legislative election was held on 21 March 2007 to elect the 12th Norfolk Island Legislative Assembly, the prime legislative body of Norfolk Island. This was the first election to use a modified electoral system, which had been introduced by the Assembly in 2005. Electors each have nine equal votes, which can be divided in any way between candidates, but no more than two votes could be given to any particular individual candidate.
